description: This file defines the FooTable.Export component, providing export functionalities such as generating JSON and CSV representations of table data, and capturing snapshots of table rows before paging.

classes.name: F.Export
classes.description: A component extending FooTable.Component that provides export functionalities for table data.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the export component, capturing a snapshot of table rows.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the current table rows before paging.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Returns an array of column definitions as simple objects.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Returns table rows as simple objects, optionally filtered.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns table data as a JSON object containing columns and rows.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Returns table data as a CSV formatted string.
